items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Gene Krupa? Yeah, Gene Krupa. You take this fellow Rich.

ctx.x: But a lot of them can't do it. I don't care who they are.

That goes for... What's this white drummer's name there? Caught with Dope. Oh... You can know him if I could call his name. Uh-huh. Gene Krupa? Yeah, Gene Krupa. You take this fellow Rich. All them fellas, they do all that stuff. They don't forgot how you make a press roll. You know what I mean? The press roll is just going out of their mind. All they want to do is just work on that stuff in front of them. Now you don't call them jazz drummers. They don't think how they make a press roll. No. They don't think how…
